mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_authorization_decision_audit ( decision_id, workspace_id, requester_issuer, requester_type, requester_id, permission_code, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason_code, policy_version, request_id, trace_id, evaluated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.decisionId}, #{row.workspaceId}, #{row.requesterIssuer}, #{row.requesterType}, #{row.requesterId}, #{row.permissionCode}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.resourceId}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.policyVersion}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.evaluatedAt} )
mapper.delete: WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT decision_id, workspace_id, requester_issuer, requester_type, requester_id, permission_code, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason_code, policy_version, request_id, trace_id, evaluated_at, agent_id, acting_grant_id FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit WHERE evaluated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY evaluated_at, decision_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), archived AS ( INSERT INTO ainer_authorization_decision_audit_archive ( decision_id, workspace_id, requester_issuer, requester_type, requester_id, permission_code, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason_code, policy_version, request_id, trace_id, evaluated_at, agent_id, acting_grant_id, archived_at ) SELECT decision_id, workspace_id, requester_issuer, requester_type, requester_id, permission_code, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason_code, policy_version, request_id, trace_id, evaluated_at, agent_id, acting_grant_id, #{archivedAt} FROM candidates ON CONFLICT (decision_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING decision_id ) DELETE FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit hot USING candidates WHERE hot.decision_id = candidates.decision_id AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived WHERE archived.decision_id = hot.decision_id) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit_archive archive WHERE archive.decision_id = hot.decision_id ) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit) AS hot, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit_archive) AS archived, (SELECT MIN(evaluated_at) FROM ainer_authorization_decision_audit) AS oldest_hot_at
